name: relativity

shorts.hook: Your head is older than your feet
shorts.say: Right now, your head is aging faster than your feet. Scientists measured it.
shorts.from: Today, clocks are even more precise

shorts.hook: E = mc squared is not in Einstein's paper
shorts.say: Einstein's famous 1905 paper never writes E equals m c squared.
Everyone thinks I float because there's no gravity up here. That's not true.

shorts.hook: Something from space is passing through you
shorts.say: Right now, tiny particles made by rays from space are passing through your body. By rights, they shouldn't survive the trip.

title: Every Confusing Thing About Einstein's Relativity Explained Slowly (For Sleep)
